comment: Generated by scripts/generate-catalogue.mjs — run `npm run catalogue`. Do not edit by hand (AGENTS.md section 6).
role: Step 3 of 3 in the abap2UI5 sample family: samples (the abap2UI5 basics) -> samples-controls (the UI5 control set) -> samples-stack (abap2UI5 together with the rest of the stack). Every sample here needs something from the system beyond an abap2UI5 installation — an OData service, a RAP business object, an APC channel, a launchpad — and its entry says what.
start: Install abap2UI5, pull this repository — or the one-package branch the entry names — with abapGit, do the setup its package README asks for, then open ?app_start=<class>.

packages.topic: the catalogue of this repository, inside your system

packages.topic: feature control, parameters, factory actions, defaults, projections
packages.needs: ABAP Platform >= 2025; the BO ships with this repo
packages.note: The package is set to the release that carries all of its features. Instance feature control, actions with parameters and factory actions are older; the default function GetDefaultsForCreate and cl_abap_behv_aux are the young ones. GET PERMISSIONS sits in z2ui5_cl_smps_perm_req, which abaplint cannot parse and therefore does not check.

samples.title: Overview — All Samples in This Repository
samples.summary: every sample in this repository, grouped by what it needs from the system
samples.needs: nothing beyond abap2UI5 — it ships on every branch and resolves every sample at runtime

samples.title: RAP Actions — Feature Control with GET PERMISSIONS
samples.summary: GET PERMISSIONS asks the business object what may happen to each request - the buttons follow its answer, and the business object refuses the rest anyway
samples.needs: ABAP Platform >= 2025; the BO ships with this repo

samples.title: RAP Actions — Parameters, Factory Actions, Defaults
samples.summary: Actions with a parameter - a default function proposes a new request, a static factory action creates it, a factory action copies one, and reject asks for its reason in a popup
samples.needs: ABAP Platform >= 2025; the BO ships with this repo

samples.title: RAP Actions — Validate on Change with a Determine Action
samples.summary: A determine action runs the validation of the business object while the user types - the quantity is checked on every change, and nothing is saved until Save
samples.needs: ABAP Platform >= 2025; the BO ships with this repo

samples.title: RAP Actions — One Business Object, Two Contracts
samples.summary: One business object, two contracts - approve through the projection Z2UI5_C_SMPS_REQ or on the business object itself, and the handler records which one it was
samples.needs: ABAP Platform >= 2025; the BO ships with this repo
